pages.text: $(item)Circuit Plates$() (smooth stone slab + redstone) are the base of every gate. $(item)Gears$(): stone (4 cobblestone in a plus), then copper, gold, iron, brass, silver and diamond around a stone gear; netherite by smithing.
The $(item)Power Circuit$() goes into electric tools and the $(item)Power Machine Casing$() (iron, brass, circuit), the body of every powered machine.

The $(item)Signal Circuit$() (signal alloy, redstone torches, circuit plate) makes the $(item)Signal Machine Casing$() (iron, tin, circuit), the body of redstone-driven machines: extractor, regulator, relay, ejector, detector, igniter, deployer, block breaker and assembler.
